description: Two independent webhook-triggered demos: a conversation-memory demo that builds a per-conversation_id transcript in a Set node before calling OpenAI, and a RAG demo that keyword-matches a question against a hardcoded knowledge base before calling OpenAI with a grounded, citation-required prompt.

parameters.content:
## Day 39 Solution: AI Memory, Context & RAG

Two independent demos in one file. (1) Memory: a webhook builds a per-conversation transcript (keyed by conversation_id) in a Set node, then an OpenAI node answers using that transcript as context. (2) RAG: a Set node holds a small hardcoded knowledge base; a second Set node does simple keyword-match 'retrieval' against the incoming question, and an OpenAI node answers only from the matched chunk, citing it.

**Credentials needed to run for real:** OpenAI API key.

**Reference:** WEEK_06_AI_AGENTS/DAILY_TASKS/DAY_39_AI_Memory_and_Context.md

## Note: Session Memory

This Set node simulates per-conversation memory by building a running transcript keyed by conversation_id within a single execution. A real production deployment would persist this transcript in a database or Redis (keyed by conversation_id) and load/save it on every call — a single n8n execution can only demonstrate the shape of that memory record, not true cross-request persistence.

values.content: You are a helpful assistant. Use the conversation transcript below — which is keyed to this specific conversation_id — to answer the latest message, recalling any facts the user has already told you in this session.

assignments.name: kb_chunk_1
assignments.value: Refunds: Students may request a full refund within 14 days of purchasing a course, provided less than 25% of the course content has been completed. Refund requests after 14 days are evaluated case-by-case and are not guaranteed.

assignments.name: kb_chunk_2
assignments.value: Course Access: Once enrolled, students have lifetime access to course materials, including any future updates to that course. Access does not expire and is not tied to a subscription.

assignments.name: kb_chunk_3
assignments.value: Certificates: A certificate of completion is issued automatically once a student finishes 100% of a course's required lessons and passes the final assessment with a score of 70% or higher.

assignments.name: kb_chunk_4
assignments.value: Support Hours: Our support team responds to help-desk tickets Monday through Friday, 9am-6pm Eastern Time, with a target first-response time of one business day. Live chat is available during the same hours for enrolled students.

assignments.name: retrieved_context
assignments.value: ={{ $json.question.toLowerCase().includes('refund') ? $json.kb_chunk_1 : ($json.question.toLowerCase().includes('access') || $json.question.toLowerCase().includes('expire')) ? $json.kb_chunk_2 : $json.question.toLowerCase().includes('certificate') ? $json.kb_chunk_3 : ($json.question.toLowerCase().includes('support') || $json.question.toLowerCase().includes('help')) ? $json.kb_chunk_4 : 'No matching chunk found in the knowledge base.' }}

values.content: Answer using only the retrieved context below. If the answer isn't in the context, say you don't know — do not use outside knowledge. Cite which knowledge-base chunk you used (e.g. 'Source: kb_chunk_2').
